description: Fix Vercel SPA 404 on page refresh by adding catch-all rewrite to vercel.json, and rename Vercel project from sandbox-nine-taupe to ashram-shala-pathraj using Vercel API
steps: Edit vercel.json to add a catch-all SPA rewrite: { "source": "/((?!api/).*)", "destination": "/index.html" } after the existing /api/(.*) rewrite

Use Vercel API (PATCH https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/<project-id>) with the provided Vercel token (REDACTED_VERCEL_TOKEN) to rename the project name from 'sandbox-nine-taupe' to 'ashram-shala-pathraj'. First GET /v9/projects to find the project, then PATCH to rename.
Verify vercel.json is valid JSON and the rewrite order is correct (API routes first, SPA catch-all last)
acceptance_criteria: vercel.json contains both /api/(.*) rewrite to /api AND a catch-all rewrite to /index.html
Vercel project has been renamed via API to ashram-shala-pathraj
findings: The Vercel project was named 'sandbox' (not 'sandbox-nine-taupe' as expected) but was linked to the ashram-shala-pathraj-portal repo. Renamed it to 'ashram-shala-pathraj' via PATCH API. Project ID: prj_EWutuTBkzEYsM3MO88474WwmBXYV. SPA catch-all rewrite uses negative lookahead /((?!api/).*) to avoid intercepting API routes.
